title: observability-platform backend chart values
description: Only `config` is constrained here. The backend loads its settings through viper's AutomaticEnv with the OBS prefix, which reads ONLY the keys internal/config/config.go declares a default for: an OBS_* variable that matches nothing is not an error, it is silently ignored, so a typo leaves the operator watching default behavior while believing they changed something. Helm validates values against this schema before rendering, which turns that silence into an install-time error. tests/e2e/helm_test.go cross-references the key list below against config.go in both directions, so it cannot drift from the code.

config.description: Backend environment variables, rendered into the ConfigMap. Every key must be one internal/config/config.go declares.

OBS_HTTP_ADDR.$comment: Listed because it is a real config key, but templates/configmap.yaml rejects it with an actionable message: service.port owns the listen address, and setting both emits the key twice in one ConfigMap.
